plain: A researcher named Dr. John Brandenburg says on Jesse Michels's podcast that, as he argues in his book Cosmic Awakening, the 1977 film Close Encounters of the Third Kind was the government's way of using Hollywood to celebrate an arrangement it had made with the grays, the gray-skinned aliens of many UFO stories. He brings in J. Allen Hynek, a UFO researcher, in telling it. If true, a famous film would have been a quiet public nod to a secret deal.
